theater: 科索沃戰區與塞爾維亞南部縱深

battle.name: 科索沃戰爭
battle.theater: 科索沃戰區與塞爾維亞南部縱深
battle.brief: 1999年3月24日，北約以「盟軍力量行動」對南斯拉夫聯盟開打空襲，七十八天後以《庫馬諾沃軍事協定》收場。卡面的F-16戰鬥機是空襲骨幹：既負責制空與壓制南軍雷達、導彈陣地，也執行晝夜縱深打擊，其出動架次與作戰損耗直接左右戰役節奏。

kit.name: F-16戰鬥機
kit.history: 1978年已列裝的美軍戰鬥機，科索沃戰爭期間配屬北約空中部隊，用於制空與對地打擊。

countries: 交戰一方是北約聯盟及其夥伴國，另一方是南斯拉夫聯盟與科索沃境內的武裝團體。北約方面由十九個創盟國的部隊與中隊組成，包括美國、加拿大、英國、法國、德國、意大利、荷蘭、西班牙、比利時、丹麥、挪威、葡萄牙、希臘、土耳其、愛爾蘭、匈牙利、波蘭、捷克與紐西蘭，另有瑞典、芬蘭、瑞士、羅馬尼亞、保加利亞等以夥伴身分派機參戰。北約歐洲司令部最高司令為克拉克上將，握有動武的政治與軍事授權；空戰由歐洲中部空軍司令部統一調度，最初由貝圖倫姆中將負責，四月起交由肖特中將；南歐方向由南歐盟軍指揮部司令史密斯上將統籌，海上重火力由以美國海軍為骨幹的地中海特混部隊出動。北盟在1999年3月12日剛接納波蘭、捷克、匈牙利三國，戰役甫開打即有該三國的機隊與部隊上陣。南斯拉夫聯盟方面，總統米洛舍維奇掌握最高權力，總理米尼奇主持聯盟政府，軍隊為南斯拉夫人民軍，科索沃境內駐有第五十二軍等部隊，內務部轄下的特種警察與地方塞族武裝團隊負責市區與鄉村的地面控制；科索沃阿爾巴尼亞族武裝則是科索沃解放軍，其指揮部設在阿爾巴尼亞境內，與流亡的政治領袖保持聯繫。北約的行動未獲聯合國安理會授權，安理會於3月31日以第1160號決議譴責此舉，但未能就動武提出異議。
countriesEn: One side was NATO and its partners; the other was the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia together with the armed groups inside Kosovo. The NATO fielded force was drawn from the nineteen founding members, among them the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Spain, Belgium, Denmark, Norway, Portugal, Greece, Turkey, Ireland, Hungary, Poland, the Czech Republic and New Zealand, while Sweden, Finland, Switzerland, Romania, Bulgaria and others flew as partners rather than as members. The political and military authorisation for the campaign rested with the Supreme Allied Commander Europe, General Wesley Clark. The air war was run by Allied Air Forces Central Europe, at first under Lieutenant General Richard Bethurem and from April under Lieutenant General Michael Short; the southern theatre was directed by the Allied Forces Southern Europe commander, Admiral Leighton Smith, with the heavy naval striking group operating out of the Mediterranean. NATO had only just admitted Poland, the Czech Republic and Hungary on 12 March 1999, and their aircraft and personnel were in the theatre before the first strike was delivered. On the Yugoslav side President Slobodan Milošević held the ultimate power and Prime Minister Milomir Minić ran the federal government, the armed forces being those of the Yugoslav Army, with the 52nd Corps and other formations stationed in Kosovo while the Interior Ministry's special police and local Serb paramilitaries controlled the towns and villages. The principal Kosovo Albanian force was the Kosovo Liberation Army, whose command centre lay across the border in Albania and stayed in contact with the exiled political leadership. The NATO action was launched without Security Council authorisation: on 31 March the Council adopted Resolution 1160 condemning it, though it could not raise an objection to the use of force.
people: 關鍵人物分三層：北約的決策者與作戰指揮官、南聯盟與科索沃雙方的領袖、國際調解人。美國總統克林頓在1998年10月接受副國務卿霍爾布魯克與米洛舍維奇達成的協議，讓北約取得在科索沃駐軍的權利，同時把南軍全面撤出列為前提；他於1999年3月22日最終批准動用武力，並明確不派地面部隊。歐洲盟軍最高司令克拉克上將於3月24日宣布北約開始執行「盟軍力量行動」，同時公布南軍必須滿足的四項要求；空軍方面，歐洲中部空軍司令部的肖特中將自4月起接管出動節奏，南歐指揮部的史密斯上將負責海空協同，8月由洛佩茲上將接任南歐指揮部。美國駐南聯盟大使布蘭克與國務卿阿爾布賴特在拉姆布依埃會談的最後一輪退出談判，俄羅斯外長伊萬諾夫、歐盟代表與聯合國秘書長安南在中間穿梭斡旋，北約秘書長索拉納負責聯盟內部的政治協調。南聯盟方面，總統米洛舍維奇是所有決策的核心，總理米尼奇主持聯盟政府的日常運作，國防當局與總參謀部主持南軍作戰；科索沃阿爾巴尼亞族方面，流亡的民主聯盟領袖魯戈瓦堅持非暴力抵抗的方針，科索沃解放軍的政治代表塔奇與軍事指揮官塞利米則主張武裝鬥爭，1998年春季的攻勢由塞利米統籌，阿爾巴尼亞的莫伊索尤總統與梅齊總理在後方提供庇護、補給與外交接應。
peopleEn: The decisive figures fall into three groups: the decision makers and operational commanders of NATO, the leaders on both the Yugoslav and the Kosovo Albanian sides, and the international mediators. President Bill Clinton in October 1998 accepted the agreement reached by Deputy Secretary of State Richard Holbrooke and Slobodan Milošević, which gave NATO the right to station troops in Kosovo while making a full Yugoslav withdrawal the precondition; on 22 March 1999 he gave final approval to the use of force, explicitly ruling out a ground operation. General Wesley Clark, Supreme Allied Commander Europe, announced the start of Operation Allied Force on 24 March and set out the four demands the Yugoslav army had to meet. In the air, Lieutenant General Michael Short of Allied Air Forces Central Europe took over the flying schedule from April, Admiral Leighton Smith at Allied Forces Southern Europe ran the sea-air coordination, and Admiral Joseph Lopez succeeded him there in August. The United States ambassador William Walker and Secretary of State Madeleine Albright walked out of the last round of the Rambouillet talks, while Russian Foreign Minister Igor Ivanov, the European Union representatives and United Nations Secretary-General Kofi Annan shuttled between the parties, and NATO Secretary-General Javier Solana handled the political coordination inside the Alliance. On the Yugoslav side President Milošević was the core of every decision, Prime Minister Minić ran the daily business of the federal government, and the defence authorities and the general staff directed the army. On the Kosovo Albanian side Ibrahim Rugova, leader of the exiled Democratic League, insisted on non-violent resistance, while Hashim Thaçi as political representative of the Kosovo Liberation Army and Sylejman Selimi as its military commander favoured armed struggle and ran the spring offensive of 1998; behind them Albanian President Alfred Moisiu and Prime Minister Lazar Meksi provided shelter, supply lines and diplomatic cover.
kits: 卡面那架F-16A是1970年代中後期才裝備北約歐洲部隊的單座單發戰鬥機，低置進氣道與機腹進氣的布局讓它能在高速下保有寬廣的視野角度，通用電氣J79渦輪噴射發動機推力約七十六千牛，開後燃器可逾一百零八千牛；武器系統包括「響尾蛇」近距空對空導彈、「閃電」中距空對空導彈與二十毫米「火神」六管機炮，每分鐘射擊可達六千發。在1999年的空襲中，F-16同時擔任制空、對地攻擊、壓制敵方防空與夜間攻擊等角色，是出動架次最多的一型。同一聯盟還出動「強襲」F-15E、首批作戰的F-117A隱形攻擊機、「超級大黃蜂」F/A-18、AV-8B「海鷂」、英國「海龍」Tornado GR4、法國「幻影」2000N與「陣風」C、E-3D預警機以及B-1B與B-2轟炸機，並以加油機群維持長程出動；水面兵力由兩棲攻擊艦與巡洋艦組成，發射數百枚「戰斧」巡洋飛彈，另以「魚叉」反艦導彈與AGM-88「哈母」反輻射導彈壓制南軍雷達與導彈陣地。南軍一方的空中與防空體系以米格-21與米格-29截擊機、米-24武裝直升機為骨幹，搭配S-75、SA-6、SA-3與「立方」防空導彈系統，預警雷達老舊、火控落後，飛行員訓練與出動率遠遜於盟軍，但開戰前已把大量飛機分散進加固掩體與廢棄礦坑，設法保存實力。地面雙方則仍以AK-74步槍、RPG-7火箭筒、M-84坦克與122毫米榴彈炮為主要裝備。
kitsEn: The F-16A on the card is a single-seat single-engine fighter that only entered service with NATO's European forces in the mid and late 1970s; the chin-mounted intake under the fuselage and the high-mounted engine let it keep a wide field of view at speed, and its General Electric J79 turbojet produced around seventy-six kilonewtons of thrust, more than one hundred and eight with afterburner. Its weapons fit included Sidewinder short-range air-to-air missiles, AMRAAM medium-range missiles and the twenty-millimetre six-barrel Vulcan cannon firing up to six thousand rounds a minute. In the 1999 campaign the F-16 flew as air-superiority fighter, strike aircraft, suppression of enemy air defences and night attacker all at once, and it was the type that logged the largest number of sorties. The same alliance also fielded the F-15E, the F-117A flying its first combat missions, the F/A-18, the AV-8B Harrier II, the British Tornado GR4, the French Mirage 2000N and Rafale C, the E-3D airborne warning aircraft, and B-1B and B-2 bombers, with tanker formations sustaining long-range sorties; the surface force was built around amphibious assault ships and cruisers that fired several hundred Tomahawk cruise missiles, backed by Harpoon anti-ship missiles and AGM-88 HARM anti-radiation missiles against Yugoslav radars and missile batteries. The Yugoslav air and air-defence system rested on MiG-21 and MiG-29 interceptors and Mi-24 armed helicopters, supported by S-75, SA-6, SA-3 and Kub surface-to-air missile systems; its early-warning radars were old and its fire control poor, and pilot training and sortie generation were far below the alliance standard, but a large part of its aircraft had already been dispersed into hardened shelters and abandoned mines to preserve the force. On the ground both sides still fought with AK-74 rifles, RPG-7 launchers, M-84 tanks and 122mm howitzers as their main equipment.
tactics: 北約把七十八天的空襲分成兩個階段。第一階段稱為「削弱」，目標是摧毀南軍的防空體系與指揮管制：先以隱形轟炸機與F-16打擊雷達站與SA-2、SA-6發射陣地，再用攔截機封住南軍戰機升空，同時以電子戰吊艙干擾雷達；制空權確立後才轉入第二階段的「打擊」。1999年北約最具特點的戰術是「隨機點解衝突」程序：每個攻擊編組由若干架次組成，攔截、壓制敵方便攜式防空導彈、壓制雷達與導彈陣地、打擊、爆擊評估各佔一次，兩兩成組、起飛時間相隔數小時並隨機變化，使南軍無法預判襲擊的節奏與航線，難以集中防空兵力迎戰。攻擊本身多用兩波打擊：第一波以雷射導引炸彈壓制加固機庫與地下工事，第二波改用自由落體炸彈攻擊同一目標，兩波之間保持數分鐘間隔。F-16在戰術上多在中高空實施雷射照射與投彈，必要時低空突入，在南軍低空雷達與高射炮威脅之下用最短時間完成照射；F-117A則專門對付加固機庫。空襲之餘，地面滲透與游擊同樣激烈：南軍大量單位分散到鄉村打游擊戰，KLA以小組滲透破壞交通線與補給線，把游擊隊與正規營的火力糾纏在一起。六月初戰局逆轉後，南軍在北部停火線附近與盟軍空襲機群反覆對峙，聯盟為避免誤擊而加設識別程序，最終由地面談判收場。
tacticsEn: NATO split the seventy-eight day air campaign into two phases. The first, called the degrade phase, aimed at destroying the Yugoslav air-defence system and the command and control that ran it: stealth bombers and F-16s first struck radar stations and SA-2 and SA-6 launch batteries, fighters then sealed the Yugoslav airfields against take-off, and electronic warfare pods jammed the radars; only after air superiority had been established did the campaign turn to the strike phase proper. The most distinctive tactic of 1999 was the Allied procedure of random point deconfliction. Each strike package was made up of a number of sorties, with separate sorties for interception, for the suppression of enemy manpads, for the suppression of radars and missile batteries, for the strike itself and for battle damage assessment; sorties flew in pairs, hours apart and at random times, so that the Yugoslavs could neither predict the rhythm of the attacks nor the routes taken, and could not mass their air defence against the threat. Individual attacks were generally mounted in two waves: the first used laser-guided bombs to suppress hardened aircraft shelters and underground works, the second dropped unguided bombs on the same target, the two waves separated by several minutes. F-16s worked mostly at medium and high altitude, designating and releasing their bombs and, where necessary, penetrating low level, completing their laser designation in the shortest possible time under the threat of Yugoslav low-level radar and anti-aircraft guns; the F-117A was kept for hardened shelters. Alongside the air campaign the ground war was fought in earnest: Yugoslav units dispersed into the villages to fight a guerrilla war, while the KLA infiltrated in small groups to cut roads and supply lines, tying the guerrillas to the firepower of the regular battalions. After the turn of the war in early June, Yugoslav forces and the alliance strike aircraft faced one another repeatedly along the northern ceasefire line, identification procedures were tightened to avoid fratricide, and the campaign was finally closed by negotiations on the ground.
data: 時間軸：北約自1999年3月24日至6月10日進行空襲，前後七十八天；拉姆布依埃會談在1998年10月與1999年3月兩度舉行，3月15日的最終文本未獲南聯盟接受；6月9日簽署《庫馬諾沃協議》，6月10日《軍事技術協定》落筆，南軍與南聯盟安全部隊於6月14日前撤出科索沃，北約部隊自6月5日起進駐。規模：戰役高峰，北約在地中海與歐洲方向部署的作戰、預警、加油與運輸飛機合計逾一千架，盟軍飛機總出動逾三萬架次，官方常引約三萬八千架次，其中打擊架次逾一萬；水面與水下兵力共發射「戰斧」巡洋飛彈約五百枚。開戰首日投入作戰飛機約一百架，打擊約二十五個目標，包括塞爾維亞南部與科索沃的雷達站、導彈陣地與軍用機場。損耗：北約方面有數架F-16在交火中因地面防空火力與自身故障而損失，其中一架於四月初被地空導彈擊落，飛行員彈射獲救，另一架在五月因空空導彈發射意外受損；各來源對北約總損失的統計從個位數到十架以上不等。南軍與內務部安全部隊在空襲中陣亡者，各方統計介乎數百至約一千人之間，而南軍的地面主力裝備基本完整。F-16的運用：美方彙總顯示，駐阿維亞諾的F-16機隊在整場戰役中出動逾四千架次，是出動架次最多的機型之一，不同統計口徑略有出入。戰前態勢：至1999年3月，超過八十萬科索沃阿爾巴尼亞族居民被迫離開家園。戰後：北約維持部隊初期約三萬人，最高峰逾五萬人，由數十個國家提供；科索沃同時由聯合國臨時行政團隊接管。
dataEn: Chronology: the NATO air campaign ran from 24 March to 10 June 1999, seventy-eight days in all. The Rambouillet talks were held twice, in October 1998 and again in March 1999, and the final text of 15 March was not accepted by the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia; the Kumanovo Agreement was signed on 9 June and the Military Technical Agreement followed on 10 June, Yugoslav army and Interior Ministry security units having withdrawn from Kosovo by 14 June, while NATO troops began entering on 5 June. Scale: at the height of the campaign the alliance had more than a thousand aircraft of the combat, warning, tanker and transport types deployed across the Mediterranean and European directions; total allied flying stood at over thirty thousand sorties, the official figure often quoted being some thirty-eight thousand, of which more than ten thousand were strike sorties; and roughly five hundred Tomahawk cruise missiles were fired from the surface and submarine force. On the first day some one hundred combat aircraft were committed against about twenty-five targets, including radar stations, missile batteries and military airfields in southern Serbia and Kosovo. Losses: a number of F-16s were lost on the NATO side to ground fire and to their own faults, one of them shot down by a surface-to-air missile in early April with the pilot ejecting safely, another damaged in May when an air-to-air missile detonated at launch; estimates of the total NATO loss range from single figures to more than ten aircraft. Yugoslav army and Interior Ministry security personnel killed by the bombing are put by different sources between several hundred and about a thousand, while the bulk of the ground equipment of the Yugoslav army survived intact. Employment of the F-16: American compilations show the F-16 squadrons based at Aviano flying more than four thousand sorties over the whole campaign, the highest figure of any type, with some variation between the counting methods. Situation before the war: by March 1999 more than eight hundred thousand Kosovo Albanian residents had been driven from their homes. After the war: the NATO-led KFOR force numbered about thirty thousand at the outset and more than fifty thousand at its peak, contributed by several dozen countries, while Kosovo was placed under the United Nations Interim Administration Mission in Kosovo.
cause: 這場戰爭的直接背景是科索沃自治權的取消與隨之而來的武裝對抗。1989年塞爾維亞當局修改科索沃的憲制安排，1990年解散其議會並宣布自治憲法失效，科索沃阿爾巴尼亞族居民在政治上被排除，魯戈瓦領導的民主聯盟主張以非暴力方式爭取權益而不成。1990年代初中期，民族主義的科索沃解放軍逐漸興起，1997年從阿爾巴尼亞走私大批武器，1998年初的攻勢迫使塞爾維亞當局以大批塞族武裝與南軍部隊反擊，戰況急劇惡化，屠殺事件與人口流離成為常態。北約介入的直接導因有三：其一是塞爾維亞當局在1998年10月拒絕接受北約提出的四項要求，即撤出特種部隊、裁撤常備軍、恢復政治對話並接受國際核查；其二是1999年1月拉查克村事件帶來的輿論與道義壓力；其三是3月15日最終文本被拒之後，南軍在靠近阿爾巴尼亞邊界的地帶對科索沃阿爾巴尼亞族村鎮動用炮火，聯合國核查團團長在3月20日前後宣稱無法繼續在科索沃執行核查，觀察員安全失去保障，國際社會認為只剩下軍事選項。而最終文本的實質，是讓北約部隊留駐科索沃、南軍撤出並由國際維和部隊接管；與其說這是對塞爾維亞的懲罰，不如說是把1995年《代頓協定》遺留的科索沃地位問題，重新放上北約可以用兵力的談判桌。
causeEn: The immediate background of the war was the abolition of the autonomy of Kosovo and the armed confrontation that followed. In 1989 the Serbian authorities rewrote the constitutional arrangements of Kosovo, in 1990 they dissolved its assembly and declared its autonomy constitution null, and the Kosovo Albanian population was excluded from political life; the Democratic League under Ibrahim Rugova campaigned for its rights by non-violent means without success. Through the early and middle 1990s the nationalist Kosovo Liberation Army grew into a force, bringing in large quantities of weapons from Albania in 1997; the offensives of early 1998 forced the Serbian authorities to answer with large numbers of Serb paramilitaries and Yugoslav army units, and the fighting deteriorated sharply, with massacres and mass flight becoming routine. Three immediate causes led to the NATO intervention. First, the Serbian authorities rejected in October 1998 the four NATO demands, namely the withdrawal of the special forces, the demobilisation of the army, the resumption of political dialogue and acceptance of international verification. Second, the massacre at the village of Račak in January 1999 created enormous moral and political pressure. Third, after the final text was rejected on 15 March, Yugoslav artillery shelled the Kosovo Albanian villages near the Albanian border, and around 20 March the head of the United Nations verification mission declared that verification in Kosovo could no longer be carried out and that the safety of the observers was no longer guaranteed, so that the international community concluded only a military option remained. The substance of the final text was the stationing of NATO troops in Kosovo, the withdrawal of the Yugoslav army and the handing over of the province to an international peacekeeping force; rather than a punishment inflicted on Serbia, it amounted to putting the Kosovo status question left unresolved by the Dayton Accords of 1995 back on the table with NATO military power behind it.
impact: 影響橫跨國際法、歐洲安全秩序與軍事學三個層面。國際法上，這是北約第一次在沒有聯合國安理會授權的情況下動用武力；1999年6月與9月兩宗國際法院程序雖認定北約在安理會相關決議未獲執行時採取行動具備法律依據，同時指出安理會的程序性角色未被取代，此案此後成為人道干預論爭的核心文本。歐洲安全上，北約在空襲前一周剛完成東擴，接納波蘭、捷克、匈牙利三國，戰後歐洲與北約的整合進度明顯加快；科索沃的最終地位問題則懸而未決，直至2008年科索沃單方面宣布獨立並獲歐盟多數成員國與美國等國家承認，才算收束。軍事學上，這是一場以空中力量單獨完成戰略目的的樣板戰役，北約由此確立不必派地面部隊也能迫使國家軍隊退卻的示範，同時也把極限施壓下的道義爭議與誤擊問題推到台前，催生了此後更嚴格的交戰規則與談判。對科索沃本身，戰爭把科索沃解放軍從游擊隊改組為全國性武裝，其部分人員進入後來的科索沃安全部隊，部分流入馬其頓與普切沃谷地的武裝；南軍地面主力雖完整撤回塞爾維亞南部，但裝備與儲備被大量消耗，加上歐洲對南斯拉夫的持續制裁，塞爾維亞的經濟與軍力在此後數年都陷於低谷。
impactEn: The consequences reached across three layers: international law, the European security order and military doctrine. In international law this was the first time NATO had used force without Security Council authorisation; the two International Court of Justice proceedings of June and September 1999 found that NATO was entitled to act when the relevant Council resolutions had not been complied with, while at the same time holding that the Council's procedural role had not been displaced, and the case became the central text of the humanitarian intervention debate. In European security, NATO had completed its first enlargement only a week before the strikes, taking in Poland, the Czech Republic and Hungary, and the integration of Europe with the alliance visibly quickened afterwards; the final status of Kosovo, however, remained open until the province declared independence in 2008 and was recognised by most European Union members and by the United States. In military doctrine the campaign became the model of a strategic objective achieved by air power alone; it established the NATO demonstration that an armed national force could be made to withdraw without a ground operation, while at the same time pushing the moral controversy of coercive pressure and the problem of fratricide to the forefront and forcing tighter rules of engagement and harder negotiations. For Kosovo itself the war turned the Kosovo Liberation Army from a guerrilla band into a national armed force, part of its men later entering the Kosovo Security Force and part flowing into the armed groups in Macedonia and the Preševo valley; the Yugoslav ground forces withdrew to southern Serbia largely intact but with their equipment and stocks heavily consumed, and with continuing European sanctions on Yugoslavia the Serbian economy and armed forces stayed in a prolonged trough.
result: 結果在軍事與政治兩個層面分開兌現。軍事上，北約的主要目標達成：南軍與南聯盟安全部隊放棄科索沃，6月10日《軍事技術協定》規定撤軍路線、序列與裝備繳付，6月14日撤軍完成，7月起北約維持部隊接替並在塞族武裝與科索沃阿爾巴尼亞族武裝之間劃出停火線，聯合國臨時行政團隊同時進駐接管行政。政治上則打了折扣：米洛舍維奇未因空襲而垮台，南軍主力完整退回塞爾維亞南部，北約承諾的塞爾維亞安全保證最終只換來一紙不具約束力的承諾；科索沃阿爾巴尼亞族武裝在戰後被解散並改組，成為新生科索沃警察與安全部隊的骨幹，而南聯盟境內的塞族分離武裝轉入普切沃谷地繼續活動，前南國際刑事法庭其後就科索沃相關案件起訴多名塞方軍警人員與一名阿方指揮官。長期看，這場戰爭既終結了塞爾維亞對科索沃的實際控制，也為塞爾維亞的政權更替、2003年聯盟解散與科索沃的獨立鋪設了道路；北約方面則在歐洲東部邊界得到一場代價相對低廉的勝利示範，也自此背上了未獲安理會授權動武的合法負擔。
resultEn: The result was paid out on two separate levels, military and political. On the military level the principal NATO objectives were met: the Yugoslav army and the security units of the Federal Republic gave up Kosovo, the Military Technical Agreement of 10 June fixed the routes, the sequence and the materiel handed over, the withdrawal was complete on 14 June, and from July the NATO-led KFOR took over, drawing a ceasefire line between the Serb and the Kosovo Albanian armed groups while the United Nations Interim Administration Mission in Kosovo entered to take over the civil administration. On the political level the result fell short: Milošević was not toppled by the bombing, the bulk of the Yugoslav army withdrew to southern Serbia intact, and the security guarantee NATO had promised Serbia came down in the end to an undertaking with no binding force; the Kosovo Albanian armed force was disbanded and reorganised after the war, its cadres becoming the backbone of the new Kosovo police and security forces, while the Serb separatist formations inside the Federal Republic moved to the Preševo valley and carried on, and the International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia later indicted several Serbian military and police figures and one Albanian commander over the Kosovo cases. In the long run the war ended Serbian control in fact over Kosovo and paved the way for the change of government in Serbia, the dissolution of the State Union in 2003 and the independence of Kosovo; for NATO it won a comparatively cheap demonstration of victory on the eastern flank of Europe, and it also took on the legal burden of having used force without Security Council authorisation.
